cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life-form more like plant seeds.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.description: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.description: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.description: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.description: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.description: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.description: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Banette
cards.description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

cards.name: Banette
cards.description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Binacle
cards.description: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.description: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom bringer.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.description: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.description: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.description: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.

cards.name: Carbink
cards.description: Born from temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.description: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. It is said to have the ability to change the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.description: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.description: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.description: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.description: It's uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.description: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speed of over 180 mph.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.description: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.description: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.description: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.description: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.description: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.description: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.description: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves fell close to anyone other than their Trainers.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.description: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.description: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.
